{"sql": "WITH paid AS (
  SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS paid_count, SUM(amount) AS total_amount
  FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid' GROUP BY customer_id
), ranked AS (
  SELECT c.id, c.region, COALESCE(p.paid_count, 0) AS paid_count,
         COALESCE(p.total_amount, 0) AS total_amount,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.region ORDER BY COALESCE(p.total_amount, 0) DESC, c.id) AS rn
  FROM customers c LEFT JOIN paid p ON p.customer_id = c.id
)
SELECT id, region, paid_count, total_amount
FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 2 ORDER BY region, rn;", "question": "请审查CTE、聚合、LEFT JOIN及分区窗口排名语义。已知 customers.id 为主键，orders.customer_id 可空，amount 可空，必须保留没有paid订单的客户，排名同额按id稳定排序。没有真实执行计划或规模数据，不得声称索引一定有效或性能提升。不要写文件，finish_analysis给出有条件建议。 请先通过knowledge.search查阅已授权的SQL语义说明，并引用实际来源；该资料不是执行权限。", "databaseId": null, "targetPath": null, "explainPlan": null}
